captions.instagram:
Cool, hazy week ahead: outskirts dip to 12-16°C

While Cyclone Akvan keeps coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha on alert, IMD Hyderabad forecasts a partly cloudy, hazy sky for the city till Nov 25. Dry northerly winds keep humidity low; eastern Telangana districts may see thunderstorms and isolated heavy rain.

Why it matters: Dry, cold northerly winds are keeping daytime humidity low and pulling night temperatures down in western and northern Telangana.

Source: Telangana Today. Image: Telangana Today
